dialogues.speaker: Mandana
dialogues.text: Thanks, I'll take it as a compliment on the good job I did for the garden.

dialogues.speaker: Mandana
dialogues.text: Cutting a fresh flower with its leaves on, put it into a vase with water, and you'll make a very nice interior decoration.

dialogues.speaker: Mandana
dialogues.text: These are for you. Beautiful flowers will bring you good luck.
